    Theses

    Towards Robust Active Planning for Autonomous Aerial Navigation

    Published in ETH Doctoral Examination, 2023

    This thesis addresses the fundamental challenges of autonomous aerial navigation in GPS-denied and obstacle-dense environments across two core pillars: decentralized multi-robot coordination and semantic perception-aware active planning. By integrating high-level semantic scene understanding and deep reinforcement learning (RL) into path planning, the proposed frameworks improve localization reliability, mission execution speed, and robot safety in real-world scenarios.

    Journal Articles

    Fast multi-UAV decentralized exploration of forests

    Published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2023

    Addressing the challenges of high obstacle density and long-distance wireless communication limits in UAV fleets, the proposed multi-robot exploration framework achieves complete coverage of complex forest environments up to 30% faster than state-of-the-art baselines. Video available here.

    Sweep-Your-Map: Efficient Coverage Planning for Aerial Teams in Large-Scale Environments

    Published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2022

    This letter proposes a pipeline that generates structured task partitions to achieve comprehensive visual coverage significantly faster than state-of-the-art exploration baselines, addressing the strict battery and flight-time constraints of small drones in large-scale outdoor missions.     Informed Sampling Exploration Path Planner for 3D Reconstruction of Large Scenes

    Published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2021

    Addressing MAV computational and energy constraints, the letter proposes a frontier-based informed sampling approach streamlines viewpoint evaluation to accelerate autonomous exploration, outperforming state-of-the-art planners in both exploration speed and final 3D reconstruction quality.     Voxfield: Non-Projective Signed Distance Fields for Online Planning and 3D Reconstruction

    Published in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2022

    Outperforming state-of-the-art methods in map coverage, accuracy, and processing speed, Voxfield operates effectively onboard compute-constrained micro-aerial vehicles (MAVs), generating accurate ESDF maps to enable real-time trajectory planning and obstacle avoidance. Video available here.

    T-PRM: Temporal Probabilistic Roadmap for Path Planning in Dynamic Environments

    Published in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2022

    Temporal-PRM maintains the core advantages of traditional PRM, such as multi-query capabilities and smooth path generation, while enabling collision-free navigation in highly dynamic, cluttered environments, operating in real time onboard a flying robot. Video available here.

    Autonomous Emergency Landing for Multicopters using Deep Reinforcement Learning

    Published in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2022

    The paper presents an autonomous emergency landing pipeline for multicopters that handles critical failures, such as mechanical malfunctions, GPS jamming, or sudden battery drops. By leveraging semantic and depth representations, our policy achieves direct zero-shot transfer to the real world without requiring any additional fine-tuning. Video available here.

    Download Paper | Download Bibtex

    Semantic-aware Active Perception for UAVs using Deep Reinforcement Learning

    Published in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2021

    The paper presents a semantic-aware path-planning pipeline for UAVs that uses deep reinforcement learning to evaluate the perceptual informativeness of visible semantic classes. By training on semantic cues across non-photorealistic, randomly generated scenes, the deep policy network successfully generalizes to unseen environments while guiding the UAV away from perceptually degraded regions. Video available here.

    Multi-robot Coordination with Agent-Server Architecture for Autonomous Navigation in Partially Unknown Environments

    Published in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2020

    A server-agent system architecture for multi-robot autonomous navigation in partially unknown environments is presented, where computationally demanding tasks like global mapping and path planning are outsourced to a central server, while agents handle local pose estimation and obstacle avoidance onboard. Video available here.

    Perception-aware Path Planning for UAVs using Semantic Segmentation

    Published in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2020

    This paper presents a perception-aware path-planning pipeline for UAVs that leverages semantic segmentation to avoid texture-less or problematic areas, such as bodies of water, that degrade monocular VIO state estimation, actively steering the robot toward perceptually informative regions.     Fully Autonomous Live 3D Reconstruction with an MAV: Hardware- and Software-Setup

    Active Learning for UAV-based Semantic Mapping

    Published in Workshop on Informative Path Planning and Active Sampling, Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS), 2019

    Addressing the labor-intensive bottleneck of training data collection in vision-based UAV applications, our novelty-aware path planner is validated on real-world terrain mapping datasets, yielding substantially smaller, more informative training datasets compared to standard lawnmower pattern collection.
